about.title: About
about.description: Who makes the things in the shop, and how.
about.statement: From one rail of shirts to a shop for things you keep.
about.first: Everything here is made in small runs by workshops we visit. When a run sells out we make it again or we do not — nothing is marked down to clear a shelf.
about.second: We would rather sell you one shirt you wear for ten years than three you replace. Bring anything back and we will mend it.
